title: Mountain Seasons Wheel
shareTitle: Mountain Seasons Wheel — A Papercraft Nature Adventure
description: Spin through a changing paper mountain, dress Juni for the weather, and discover a plant and animal in every season.
learningGoals: Connect spring, summer, autumn, and winter with visible weather changes
Choose clothing that fits concrete seasonal weather
Discover how mountain plants and animals change through the year
interactionModel: flick or tap a four-part wheel, choose a garment, then tap authored plant and animal discoveries
feedbackModel: The mountain transforms in place, Juni changes outfit, discoveries open narrated field notes, and each completed season earns a paper stamp.

modes.title: Season Adventure
modes.skill: connect a season with weather, plants, and animals

modes.title: Dress for Weather
modes.skill: choose clothing that fits concrete weather
